messages:
eve_prod: Hey team — after we switched traffic to SaturnPrime-v1 yesterday, our p99 for long-window requests (~8k-12k tokens) jumped from ~850ms to ~2.6s and we’re seeing intermittent 504s. Request id 62f9c1a8, example attached (first 2k tokens redacted). Any quick guidance?

alice_support: Thanks @eve_prod — can you paste the exact model string (as reported by the API) and the approximate input length for that request?

eve_prod: model: saturn-prime:v1, input_tokens: 10342, also using streaming=true. We saw p95 increase too but p99 is the worst. No code changes on our side.

alice_support: Got it. Can you run with streaming=false and see if the p99 changes (just to isolate streaming path)? Also what's your batching concurrency?

eve_prod: setting streaming=false briefly dropped single-request latency to ~1.9s p99 (still high). Concurrency=4, max_batch_size unset (default).

alice_support: ok escalating to runtime + ml — @bob_infra @carol_ml can you take a look? deploy-bot: Rolling up logs for request 62f9c1a8 :white_circle:

bob_infra: I'm seeing a correlation with X-KV-Cache-Miss header on that run — miss rate ~78% for long sequences around that time window. Also host-level GPU util stayed <40% which suggests latency isn't pure compute-saturation.

carol_ml: quick read: tokenizer stats show token count reported to runtime was 12,184 (vs our input estimate 10,342) — subtoken expansion ~17%. That's consistent with the new BPE merges in saturn-prime:v1. More subtokens => longer kv-chains and more attention steps.

dave_sre: putting this together: higher subtokens => longer autoregressive steps; combined with high kv-cache misses we get repeated host transfers and queuing. That increases tail quite a bit.

alice_support: thanks. Any quick mitigations we can recommend to customer?

carol_ml: immediate mitigation options: 1) roll back to saturn-stable:v3 for affected routes, 2) pin saturn-prime with a tokenization shim (normalize with legacy BPE) — we can supply a compatibility flag, 3) set max_input_tokens cap or truncation for long requests, 4) enable model-variant fallback (saturn-prime-quant) that has smaller vocab expansion.

bob_infra: practical hotfix from infra: enforce per-request path that bypasses continuous batching for >6k token requests so they don't get shuffled into small-batch windows causing cache churn. We can toggle that at routing layer as emergency toggle.

eve_prod: prefer not to roll back customer-wide; can we try fallback to saturn-prime-quant and reduce concurrency to 2 while we investigate?

dave_sre: recommended immediate steps we applied for this tenant: set routing policy -> fallback to saturn-prime-quant for that tenant, reduce concurrency to 2, disable continuous batching for requests >6k tokens. Please verify impact in next 30m. :eyes:

(15m later)

eve_prod: update — p99 dropped to ~1.1s, p95 ~750ms. No 504s in last 10 minutes. Good improvement.

carol_ml: root cause summary for record: saturn-prime:v1 includes new BPE merges and normalization that increase subtoken counts for certain long-context inputs. This increased effective sequence length, which exposed two runtime behaviors: 1) our continuous-batching windows and kv-cache eviction thresholds weren't tuned for the longer-than-expected KV chains, causing cache misses and host transfer overhead; 2) streaming path has higher overhead for longer sequences when token counts exceed internal thresholds. Both combined to inflate the tail.

bob_infra: next infra tasks: (a) make continuous-batching policy aware of per-model tokenization expansion factor, (b) add per-model kv-cache sizing heuristic, (c) add a routing circuit-breaker that directs >X token requests to dedicated long-context workers.

carol_ml: next ML tasks: (a) add tokenizer metadata (expected subtoken multiplier) to model manifest so orchestrator can make routing decisions, (b) evaluate compact vocab variant for saturn-prime and release saturn-prime-lite, (c) add unit in onboarding pipeline to run token-expansion tests on a corpus of long-docs.

alice_support: I've advised @eve_prod on mitigations and will keep thread open. We’ll follow up with a summary and ETA for infra/ml fixes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback scheduled? No — we performed a tenant-level fallback to saturn-prime-quant at 1716509000.

eve_prod: thanks all, that fallback worked — please keep us posted when a permanent fix is available.

alice_support: noted, action items captured. Assigning owners: bob_infra -> infra tasks, carol_ml -> tokenizer + model variants. We’ll post a short postmortem once the change lands. :white_check_mark:
